Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Declares a custom scan provider from a class implementing [IPgCustomScan&lt;TState&gt;](/api/ankus.ipgcustomscan-1/).

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class, Inherited = false)]
public sealed class PgCustomScanAttribute : Attribute
```

Ankus registers the provider when PostgreSQL loads the extension library and offers it every plain table the
planner scans in that backend. EXPLAIN shows the chosen scan as <code>Custom Scan (</code><i>name</i><code>)</code>.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object), [Attribute](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.attribute)

### Name

Gets or sets the name PostgreSQL registers and EXPLAIN shows, defaulting to the class name in snake_case.

```csharp
public string? Name { get; set; }
```

Value: [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The name is case-sensitive, must be unique in the backend and must fit 63 UTF-8 bytes.
